package.name: actuo_rviz_plugins
package.description:
RViz 2 panels for an actuo bus servicer: per-joint servo (torque) ON/OFF via the SetServo action, with the jump each joint would make shown before the button, and a read-only /diagnostics view.
C++ because RViz 2 panels are pluginlib C++ only -- there is no Python panel plugin (which is why comparable tools, e.g. rcb4's kxr_rqt_plugin, are rqt). The panels carry no protocol knowledge: they speak one action and a few topics and know nothing of buses, registers or motors.
